easyPrerequisites: There are legal target(s) for Pegasus Guardian // Rescue the Foal.
description:
Cast Pegasus Guardian // Rescue the Foal by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Pegasus Guardian // Rescue the Foal, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Pegasus Guardian // Rescue the Foal, blinking Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.
